submissions.hypothesis: Stable Ridge baseline establishes the first official reference score.
Fused safe, medium, and high-risk signals with base high component rank 14.
Candidate 099 made the first verified improvement over Candidate 087 but stayed too correlated, so it anchors an aggressive trained search.
Candidate 129 moved too far from Candidate 099 and became a negative feedback anchor.
Candidate 159 improved by controlled rebound and becomes the noise-aware training anchor.
Candidate 199 validates the noise-aware denoising direction and anchors V2.
Candidate 249 matched Candidate 199, so it anchors the no-gain direction for V3.
Candidate 269 improved over Candidate 199 but still requires high-risk row-level reconstruction for a larger jump.
